narrative.overview: Mediyaz presents a visual environment defined by clean, premium, and serene aesthetics. As a high-trust reproductive medical platform, it rejects flashy decorations and complex elements to prioritize patient accessibility, data clarity, and high-trust clinical precision. Spacing is comfortable, layouts are uncluttered, and interactions are designed to feel calm and deliberate.
keyCharacteristics: Muted color relationships with strict attention to data and privacy layout boundaries

rules.name: The Absolute Focus Rule
rules.body: Accent colors (like destructive red or clinical teal) must be used on <=10% of any given screen. Rarity emphasizes critical actions and fields.

rules.name: The Ambient Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows are omitted at rest. Soft ambient shadows (0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)) appear only as interactive responses to focus or hover states on cards, dialog overlays, and dropdown panels.

rules.name: The Consistent Corner Rule
rules.body: Primary cards, input blocks, buttons, and alert bars utilize a consistent corner radius of 10px (rounded.lg). Subtle child components utilize 8px (rounded.md) or 4px (rounded.sm).

dos: Do wrap service catalog grids in direct slug links to specific details pages.
Do format all price strings using the Indian Rupee symbol (₹).
Do align the tracking status layout to match actual ConsultationRequest and DonorRegistration database schemas.
donts: Don't use any AI icons (Sparkles) anywhere on the site.
Don't add duplicate CTAs or action buttons in the navigation header or page footers.
Don't render financial donation indicators or charts on the administrative dashboard panels.
